newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Read-Rite trading higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Read-Rite trading higher.

text.p: Read-Rite Corp and Altera Corp were trading higher in the after-hours session after releasing their quarterly earnings, traders said Wednesday.
Read-Rite was trading at 31, up 3/8 from its close of 29-5/8 on the NASDAQ National Market, while Altera was at 42-1/4 against 41-7/8 at the close.
"It's because of earnings," one of the traders said.
Read-Rite reported first-quarter earnings of $0.12 a share against $0.88 for the same period a year ago. Altera released earnings for its fourth-quarter of $0.31 against $0.30.

The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume totalling 12,500 shares compared to Tuesday's 7,200. Session two had a much bigger volume of 1,574,100 shares against 217,900 the previous day.
